summary: MSC Income Fund, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Master Note Purchase Agreement for $150 million of 6.83% Series A Senior Notes due 2029. The notes are unsecured, rank pari passu with existing unsecured debt, and were issued in two tranches ($75M on Sept 1, 2026, and $75M in Oct 2026). Proceeds will refinance maturing 4.04% notes due Oct 30, 2026, and repay revolving credit facilities. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special-situation event. No deal terms apply; watch for covenant compliance and execution of the second tranche.
